notes.title: PLUTO'S HOTFIX NOTES: 12/01/23
notes.notes:
Endless zones are now unlockable by defeating the first boss in the game!

White flower's spawn rate in endless challenge zones increased from 30s to 90s.

Pig ray attack sound lowered.

The Dark Knight's Playbook ability has changed to Demon Spike. The proc chance is raised to 10%.

Entering the same dungeon right after defeating that same dungeon is no longer be possible.

Leaving a steam review is the best way to support the project right now! <(^_^)<

Thanks for playing,
-V

notes.title: Hotfixes
notes.notes:
PLUTO'S HOTFIX NOTES:
11/30/23

Thanks for all the feedback! Here are some quick hotfixes.

Fixed teleports out when returning from Castle Pass and/or Sewers optional dungeons.

Fixed critical hit chance sometimes stacking infinitely resulting in constant %100 crit and easy runs.

Fixed a bug that was not allowing progress through to the final level even with the proper requirements.
